title: Turn Hours of Financial Analysis into Minutes with Rabbet’s MCP Connector
summary: Rabbet's MCP connector gives AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT read-only access to your project data. Ask about contingency, draws, funding sources, or lien waivers in plain language and get answers from your actual numbers.
body_markdown:
Today we're announcing the Rabbet MCP connector.


Here's what it does: You give an AI assistant like Claude, Copilot, or ChatGPT read-only access to your Rabbet data, and it answers from your actual budgets, draws, funding sources, and vendors instead of guessing. Nothing to build. An administrator turns it on, you sign in with your own Rabbet login, and you're done.[More on setup and security →](https://rabbet.com/blog/what-is-the-rabbet-mcp-a-guide-to-ai-in-real-estate-development-finance)


### **Why it works here and not everywhere**


The uncomfortable truth about AI in this industry is that most of the data isn't ready for it.


You know how this goes. The budget is in a spreadsheet. Costs are in a different one. Draw history is somewhere in an email thread. The funding sources are in a term sheet nobody's opened since closing. An AI assistant pointed at that mess will give you something confident and wrong, which is worse than nothing.


Rabbet customers are in a different spot, and not because of anything they did this week. Budgets, cost history, draws, funding sources, vendors, and document statuses. All of that is already organized, already reconciled, and already attached to the right project. It happens naturally as a byproduct of running draws.


### **What people are asking it**


These are the questions that used to mean a data export and a complex spreadsheet:


- How much do I need to move from contingency into this line item to cover these invoices and keep it in line with where the project actually is?
- Is the contingency I have left enough to finish?
- Which line items are billing ahead of progress, and which haven't moved in three draws?
- What's drawn against each funding source, and is anything about to tap out?
- Which vendors have we paid without a lien waiver on file?
- What do I need to cover on tomorrow's lender call?
- Across my active projects, which ones should I be worried about this week?


One team used the connector for a budget reconciliation that would otherwise have required hours of manual cross-comparisons.


"I just used it today to ask about where to move certain invoices in the budget, then had it calculate what would be needed to reallocate from contingency to keep those line items at a certain percentage. It was a huge time-saver, " shared Jeremy, VP, Director of IT and Field Operations, QuickDraw Fund Control.


### **Getting started**


The MCP Connector is available now for[Rabbet Development](https://rabbet.com/developers/product-overview) (for real estate developers) and[Rabbet Construction Lending](https://rabbet.com/lenders/product-overview) (for construction lenders) customers on the Premium tier. Talk to support or your CSM and they'll switch it on.


Not a customer? The reason this AI integration works is that the data underneath it is already structured.[See how Rabbet works.](https://rabbet.com/request-meeting)
